omar.li: Quick heads up 125  I moved from NY to BC on 2025-11-02 but my last 3 paystubs still show NY state tax and US federal withholding. I updated address in ADP but not sure if payroll saw it. Can payroll switch me to Canadian payroll prospectively and fix any retro withholdings?
jess-peopleops: Thanks Omar. Can you confirm the exact date you became Canadian resident for tax purposes and upload proof (lease or utility + work authorization) to the HR portal? We'll need that to start the cross-border process.
omar.li: Residency date is 2025-11-02. Uploaded lease + copy of PR card to Portal > Documents > Payroll. I also filled the relocation form last week.
rachel-payroll: Thanks  received the uploads. A few notes: 1) We'll request the vendor to stop US withholding for pay periods after 2025-11-02 and start Canadian payroll for post-move periods. 2) For any US withholding that occurred after that date we typically either reallocate wages to Canada or issue a W-2c; the Canadian vendor will issue a T4 for Canadian wages. 3) This process often needs 2-4 weeks after vendor receives paperwork.
intl-bot: Ticket PR-4992 created for Omar Li: cross-border payroll conversion. Status: awaiting vendor action and confirmation of residency docs.
omar.li: Will this change my benefits deductions or RRSP/401k enrollment? I have pre-tax 401(k) deferrals currently.
rachel-payroll: Good Q. Your US 401(k) deferrals stop once US payroll stops; Canadian retirement (RRSP) enrolment is separate and may require new elections. We'll coordinate with benefits to avoid double deductions. Any mechanical YTD changes will be noted in PR-4992.
jess-peopleops: Also expect that you may need to file part-year returns in both countries for 2025. We'll attach our cross-border tax guidance to the ticket and can connect you with our tax partner if needed.
omar.li: Awesome, thanks. Any actions I should take now besides what I uploaded?
rachel-payroll: No further docs for now. We'll confirm with the vendor once they accept the residency change. We'll post updates here and in PR-4992. Expect an initial vendor confirmation in ~10 business days.
jess-peopleops: Thanks Omar  marking this thread for follow-up and adding checklist to the ticket. Feel free to ping here if you don't hear by 2025-12-05.
